name: cloudflare-tokengate
description: Self-hosted credential broker for Cloudflare Workers (pnpm workspace root). The Worker lives in apps/gateway, the design system in packages/ui and its docs in packages/docs (served by the gateway in local development only).

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: bash scripts/check-threat-ids.sh && bash actions/get-token/test.sh && node scripts/check-links.mjs && pnpm -r run test:scripts
